Centrolene
azulae
, the
Cordillera Azul giant glass frog
,
[
2
]
is a species of
frog
in the family
Centrolenidae
.
[
3
]
It is threatened by
habitat loss
, and is included in the
IUCN Red List
.
[
3
]
Endemic
to
Peru
, its natural
habitats
are subtropical or tropical moist
montane forests
and
rivers
. It was originally described in the genus
Centrolenella
, until 1993.
